lines.text: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan, the LORD tells Moses to give the Levites cities and pasturelands.
The Levites receive forty-eight cities in all, six of them cities of refuge, given in proportion to each tribe's inheritance.
Three cities of refuge are across the Jordan and three in Canaan, open to Israelites and foreigners who kill unintentionally.
The assembly protects the manslayer, who must live in his city of refuge until the death of the king.
No one may be executed on one witness's testimony, and the LORD says no ransom may be accepted for a murderer.
